subject: Security exhibit: integrated evidence playbook + MSA/Order Form questions
messages:
From: Carol Hernandez <carol.hernandez@medicorps.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medicorps.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit - SOC 2 evidence cadence and pen-test window

Laura —

Thanks for sending the MSA and order form. Our legal/security teams had a first pass on the security exhibit and came back with three asks we want to align on before we move to signatures:

1) Evidence cadence: we need a clear, recurring cadence for SOC 2 artifacts and evidence handoffs (quarterly? ad-hoc on request?). Please share a sample evidence matrix and a proposed cadence.

2) Pen test language & window: we want to schedule an external pen test annually with a 30-day window notice. We also need clarity on scope (production vs staging), and what the escalation path looks like if critical issues are found.

3) Audit rights: the redline proposes broad audit rights — our legal asks for narrower language limiting audit scope to systems that process Medicorps production data and requiring mutually agreed auditors. Can you propose compromise wording?

I attached our redlines to the security exhibit for reference.

If it helps, can we propose a short playbook (roles/responsibilities, evidence owner list, contact on-call) so we don't have to negotiate each doc request?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call to move faster.

Carol Hernandez
Sr. Contracts & Privacy Manager
Medicorps
carol.hernandez@medicorps.com

Attachments: medicorps_redlines_security_exhibit_v1.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Carol Hernandez <carol.hernandez@medicorps.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit - SOC 2 evidence cadence and pen-test window

Carol —

Appreciate the clear asks. High-level responses and proposed playbook below; detailed redlines and an evidence matrix attached.

1) Evidence cadence: we typically provide a quarterly evidence package (SOC 2 report + supplemental artifacts) and support ad-hoc evidence requests for specific incidents/assessments. Attached is our Redwood evidence matrix template — we suggest a quarterly cadence with a 10-business-day SLA for delivering documented artifacts once the request is accepted.

2) Pen test: acceptable to Medicorps to run an annual external test. Proposal: pen test window is 30 calendar days (customer provides preferred 2-week windows within that period), scope limited to production systems that handle Medicorps production data unless you request staging. We will require the vendor to be mutually agreed and to follow our pen test rules (no disruptive testing outside agreed times; immediate out-of-band notification for critical findings).

3) Audit rights: proposed compromise language below (we will send as redline):

"Customer may, no more than once per year and upon reasonable prior notice, engage an independent auditor to review Redwood controls as they relate to Customer's production data. Scope must be limited to systems and procedures that directly process or store the Customer's production data; the auditor must be mutually acceptable to the parties and bound by Redwood's confidentiality obligations. Audits shall be conducted during normal business hours and shall not unreasonably interfere with Redwood operations."

Playbook (suggested):
- Evidence owner: Marissa Cole (Security Ops) — will assemble quarterly package and ad-hoc artifacts.
- Pen test owner: Karthik Iyer (Legal/Procurement lead for vendor approval).
- On-call for emergency findings: security-oncall@redwood.com (SRE).
- Delivery channel: secure SharePoint/Drive folder + expiring links.

Next steps: 1) confirm you accept the proposed audit-language compromise, 2) pick preferred 30-day pen-test window in June–July, and 3) Marissa will share the evidence matrix by EOD Monday.

Attached: redwood_evidence_matrix_template_v1.xlsx, proposed_security_exhibit_redline.docx

Happy to hop on a call if you'd rather walk through.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships (Contracts liaison)
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_evidence_matrix_template_v1.xlsx, proposed_security_exhibit_redline.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Medicorps redlines — playbook and legal posture

Team —

Looping you in after Carol's redline. Quick plan so we move fast and keep the customer happy without creating precedent:

Summary of asks from Medicorps: quarterly evidence cadence vs ad-hoc access, annual external pen test with 30-day window, tighten audit rights to mutually agreeable auditor and scope.

Proposed Redwood posture (my recommendations):
- Evidence cadence: agree to quarterly delivery + ad-hoc requests with a documented evidence matrix. Offer a 10-business-day delivery SLA for standard artifacts and 20-business-days for deeper traces/log-level exports that require engineering effort.
- Pen test: accept annual external pen test; require mutually agreed vendor and a limited scope that excludes internal admin tooling and third-party provider consoles. Require a signed Rules of Engagement (RoE). We should also insist on a 30-calendar-day cooldown before public disclosure for any findings, to allow remediation.
- Audit rights redlines: concede to limited audit once/year with mutually acceptable auditor, but include explicit language excluding forensic-level access to raw customer traffic logs unless there's a legal obligation (subpoena, etc.). Also change all timing references to "business days" where operational.

Legal/tactical notes for redlines:
- Replace "reasonable notice" with explicit "30 calendar days' prior notice" for audits.
- Replace any blanket "access to systems" language with "access to documentation, evidence artifacts, and scope-limited interviews with personnel."
- Add a clause that any operational burden (engineering time > 8 hours) will be scoped and may incur a professional services charge.

Marissa — can you confirm which artifacts we can deliver within 10 business days and which ones take longer? Also please prepare an evidence package outline and mark the owner for each artifact in the spreadsheet.
Karthik — if you can provide the short clause language for the RoE for pen testing and the legal redlines (2–3 bullets), I will fold into the redline doc and send back to Carol. 

I'll prepare a consolidated reply once I have both pieces.

Thanks —
Laura

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Carol Hernandez <carol.hernandez@medicorps.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, security@medicorps.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit - integrated evidence playbook and next steps

Carol —

Thanks again for the redlines. We've reviewed internally and put together a concise playbook and set of compromise redlines attached. Key points:

- Evidence cadence: Redwood will provide a quarterly evidence package (SOC 2 + supporting artifacts). For ad-hoc evidence requests, we will deliver standard artifacts within 10 business days; engineering-level artifacts may take up to 20 business days.
- Pen testing: we agree to a yearly external pen test. Scope limited to production systems that process Medicorps production data unless you explicitly request staging. The vendor must be mutually agreed; Redwood will require a signed Rules of Engagement (RoE) that we drafted (attached). Proposed pen-test window: June 21–July 20 (30-day window) — please confirm your preferred two-week testing window inside that period.
- Audit rights (compromise language included in attached redline): single audit per 12-month period with 30 calendar days' notice; scope limited to systems/procedures that directly relate to Medicorps production data; auditor must be mutually acceptable and bound by confidentiality. Audits will be operationally scoped to documentation, interview, and evidence artifacts — no unrestricted forensic access to raw network traffic unless required by subpoena.

Attachments included: consolidated_security_exhibit_redline.docx, redwood_evidence_matrix_template_v1.xlsx, pen_test_RoE_template.docx

Next actions:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the audit-language compromise and the pen-test window by EOD Wednesday.
2) If accepted, Marissa will provision the secure evidence folder and send expiring links; Karthik will kick off vendor approval for the pen test.

If you'd like a 30m sync to finalize language, we can do that — otherwise we'll proceed to update the order form and push to signature.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: consolidated_security_exhibit_redline.docx, redwood_evidence_matrix_template_v1.xlsx, pen_test_RoE_template.docx
